The vertical axis scale ranges from 0 to 20, not 1 to 20.

errors.text_span: with tick labels spaced uniformly every 2 units

errors.evidence: This description implies there are only six bars in total. The chart is a grouped bar chart with four groups of six bars each, corresponding to the categories on the x-axis. The description completely fails to mention this grouped structure.

errors.text_span: the approximate heights of the bars are 10.2, 11.4, 6.1, 8.7, 9.3, and 5.1 respectively
